description: Points the domain and its www at the practitioner's website hosted by Practisan (on Netlify). Only these two website records are set: email records (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and every other record stay exactly as they are.
variableDescription: site: the website's Netlify name, the part before .netlify.app (for example example-practice for example-practice.netlify.app)
